summary: Annona was a male Nomai bridge officer on Escall's Vessel and the original creator of Warp Core technology. He landed on Ember Twin with Escape Pod 2 after the crash, helped found the Sunless City, took Poke as his apprentice, and passed on his warp-core designs before his death.

location: Annona was a bridge officer on Escall's Vessel.
Annona landed on Ember Twin with Escape Pod 2 after the Vessel crashed.
lore: Annona was the original creator of the Warp Core technology.
Annona's advanced warp core designs were shared at Nomai festivals so all Nomai clans could warp long distances.
Annona served alongside Filix as a bridge officer on Escall's Vessel.
When the Vessel received the Eye's signal, Annona warned Escall the warp would be significant and the core would need time to recharge.
Annona and Filix checked the warp core and navigation systems before warping; both functioned properly.
After landing on Ember Twin, Annona agreed with Melorae that the survivors should build long-term shelter in the cave system.
Annona endorsed Melorae's chosen cavern as the site for the Sunless City.
Annona helped build a Quantum Moon Locator and observed the Moon's quantum properties.
Annona confirmed the Quantum Moon orbits multiple planets including Brittle Hollow and Timber Hearth.
Annona hypothesized the Quantum Moon was a form of macroscopic quantum mechanics due to its reluctance to move while consciously observed.
Annona participated in the search for the young Coleus when he got lost in a cave on Ember Twin's north pole.
Annona took Poke as his apprentice; Poke was a Nomai born in this solar system.
Annona explained many of his warp core designs to Poke before his death.
Annona's teachings allowed Poke to recreate his warp technology after his death.
